title: ClickHouse Cloud API key secret (4b1d): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 4 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: -x glued after the 38-byte body, boundary: _ glued before 4b1d, and boundary: _x glued after the 38-byte body, and 1 more. Twin of "ClickHouse Cloud API key secret (4b1d): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of clickhouse-cloud-api-secret-bare-prose: boundary: a glued before 4b1d, so the run reads a4b1d…. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
